sections.Profile:
The Crazy Clock pinball machine, released by Sega Enterprises, Ltd. in 1972, is an electro-mechanical, two-player game.

- Manufacturer: Sega Enterprises, Ltd.
- Years made: 1972–1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Backbox Gimmick, Dancing, Original Theme, 1970s
